d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attends the ceremonial reception for Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi. Shah is on a two-day state visit to India, marking his first bilateral visit since taking office in March 2026. The visit includes high-level talks on trade, connectivity, energy and infrastructure cooperation. Both leaders are also expected to review the full range of India-Nepal relations and discuss regional and international issues of mutual interest.
